# Why does temperature affect a battery's available capacity?
High temperatures affect the battery's service life according to a common “rule of thumb” or the law of “Arrhenius,” which states that the corrosion rate will be doubled at 10° C. Therefore, the lifetime will be halved per 10° C increase in temperature.

- Fifteen years at 20° C becomes reduced to 7.5 years at 30°C
